# IKEA

> > Global home furnishings retailer offering affordable Swedish-designed furniture, home accessories, food products, and planning tools with a membership rewards program.

IKEA provides comprehensive shopping experiences including furniture planning tools like IKEA Kreativ, a loyalty program (IKEA Family), Swedish restaurants and bistros, and customer support services. The site serves customers across multiple regions with localized content for furniture shopping, design planning, and food offerings.

## Key Topics

- IKEA Family loyalty program
- IKEA Kreativ 3D planning
- Swedish Restaurant & Bistro
- Swedish Food Market
- Design and planning tools
- Plant-based food options
- Membership benefits and rewards
- 365-day return policy
- IKEA App
- Meatballs and Swedish cuisine
- Kitchen and bathroom planners
- Price protection
- Customer support services
- IKEA Planning Studio
- Free membership program

## Customer Support & Policies

- [Return policies - IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/us/en/customer-service/returns-claims/): 365-day return policy & 90-day mattress exchange guarantee details

## Planning & Design Tools

- [Design and planning tools - IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/us/en/planners/): Kitchen, bathroom & furniture planning tools including IKEA Kreativ 3D

## Membership & Rewards

- [IKEA Family – Join our club for free - IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/us/en/ikea-family/): IKEA Family loyalty program with exclusive offers, benefits & rewards

## Food & Dining

- [Swedish Food & Drinks - IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/us/en/cat/ikea-food-restaurant-fb001/): Swedish food, meatballs & plant-based items at IKEA Restaurant & Market
- [IKEA Swedish Restaurant: A Perfect Shopping Break - IKEA](https://www.ikea.com/ae/en/stores/restaurant/): Swedish Restaurant menu with meatballs, salmon & local Middle East flavors

## Optional

- [Inter IKEA Group - Inter IKEA Group](https://www.inter.ikea.com/): Inter IKEA Group corporate franchisor & supply chain business overview
